eligible_conditions: Prior identification of impaired fasting glucose or glucose intolerance
Overweight (BMI > 25 but < 30 kg/m²) with at least one additional risk factor
Family history of diabetes with at least one additional risk factor
Age 65 or older with at least one additional risk factor
History of gestational diabetes mellitus or delivery of a baby weighing more than 9 pounds with at least one additional risk factor
exclusions: Tests performed more frequently than two times within a 12-month period (unless medically necessary for diagnostic purposes)
Tests performed for diagnostic purposes (covered under different benefit categories)
